Page 4 gives these costs:
- Diagnostic radiology services (e.g. MRI, CT scan): in network, $0 copay for each diagnostic mammogram and $320 copay otherwise. Out of network, 30% coinsurance.
- Outpatient X-rays: $30 copay in network and $35 copay out of network.

Items 12, 14 and 15 fail on benefit choice. The radiology row covers all diagnostic radiology, of which MRI and CT are only examples, so it is not priced for advanced imaging alone. For item 15, the mammogram exception appears only in the in-network column, so the 30% is not stated for mammograms specifically.
